cohort.public_information: source original image[7][7][3],direction,mission text and own action before-after reward terminal; no hidden state
cohort.source_custody: scan committed parent research/lcrm01 and docs/research for fresh seed identity; disjoint from previously exposed cohorts; no disconnected-branch certification
cohort.memory: public action/value counts persist only within family across three genuine DEV seeds, each role independently; episode-local proxy/guard state resets on env.reset

mechanism.type: empirical source-selected action3 effect-value when engineered exact target matcher finds an object directly in original public front; not autonomously learned semantic objective discovery
mechanism.engineered_matcher: original literal pickup mission color and object name parsed from public mission, matched to public front type/color; door mission gets no target bonus; handcrafted MiniGrid object/color mappings
mechanism.matcher_prior: exact mission target in public front adds fixed +4.0 to action3, in BOTH candidate and no-action-value ablation
mechanism.value_updates: only own selected action3 with exact public target front: increment attempt. count success only when same direction and before exact front target disappears to public empty type1; otherwise increment failure
mechanism.learned_value_adjustment: when enabled and target matches, add 3.0*(success+1)/(attempts+2) minus 6.0*failures/(attempts+2). When disabled add zero learned value. Counts maintained/updated in BOTH arms.
mechanism.source_policy_identity: apart from frozen target-match/value addition, original MG42 choose text, public memory, reverse guard and all navigation logic unchanged; original MG42 itself is third independent matcher-OFF control
mechanism.handoff: mission matcher and object/color mapping hand-engineered and must be labeled; empirical action outcomes are agent-selected source consequence evidence, not proof it discovered mission semantics; do not use env inventory

measures.positive_goal: original reward >0 and terminated; original goal episodes per family
measures.selected_target_attempt: selected original action3 with exact source public target directly ahead
measures.selected_target_effect: target disappears to public type1, same direction after selected action3
measures.target_visibility: real before source image target anywhere and exact front, with unique public views separated
measures.learned_value: within each actual source role family, number selected exact target action3 trials, public source success/failure and cold checkpoint continuity
measures.secondary: genuine 7-action histograms, real door opens, original selected actions, immediate public pickup->drop reversal pairs, target exposure per family
measures.resource_boundary: equal 192 original source action caps, unqualified full Go CPU/RSS/energy parity and independently sealed transfer

require_all: candidate >=1 own selected exact original mission target pickup effect in unfamiliar pickup families
candidate >=2 distinct unfamiliar pickup families have true positive goal episodes
candidate >=1 actual goal in UnlockPickup OR BlockedUnlockPickup
candidate unfamiliar positive-goal episode total exceeds each frozen conventional comparator (including no-learned-value ablation)
candidate genuine target-front own selected pickup effect count exceeds same-matcher no-action-value arm
source-only verified exact MG42 choose plus frozen target/value addition; dual OS PASS before any original source action; two independent full original source processes identical
frozen_dev_filter.notes: failure is valid negative data, no posthoc threshold adjustment or successful DEV->scientific promotion
